title: 第107章 不服，来战！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 唐逸看着身侧的神采飞扬的炎文帝，只觉得这皇帝怕是真疯了。　　战胜他，可以和他炎文帝提一个条件，而且还没有限制……　　你妹哦！　　人家和你要皇位你给吗？人家要大炎土地你给吗？人家要割地封王你给吗？　　简直疯了！　　饶是两世为人，唐逸这时候都心头都有些发毛，炎文帝玩得太大了。　　果然听了炎文帝的话，所有参赛的才子学子眼睛亮得吓人，只要将唐逸打趴下，他们可以和皇帝要官，一飞冲天。　　“唐逸，请赐教！”　　“唐逸，有什么本事就使出来吧？今日我必败你。”　　“小诗仙又如何？今日老子和你拼了！”　　“……”　　顷刻间，鹿鸣湖就爆炸了。　　所有参赛的才子学子，全都撸着袖子，一个个都死死盯着唐逸，大有一言不合就开干的架势。　　唐逸看着这一幕都懵逼了，差点忍不住一巴掌就往炎文帝的后脑勺甩过去。　　大哥，我们真的是一伙的吗？怎么感觉你是敌人派来的探子啊！　　你这三言两句不是提高我的士气，是将敌人的士气提到了巅峰了。　　有句话不知道当讲不当讲：我去你大爷的！　　“陛下，竟然对他如此信任？！”文臣这边，刘温看着这一幕脸色也是难看至极，他也没想到炎文帝对唐逸的信任竟然到这一步。　　唐敬，赵柯等人也都是脸色铁青，难以置信。　　都说帝王心海底针，帝王都是多疑的，但现在的炎文帝……怎么感觉在唐逸的面前，智商都快成负的了？　　这还是那个他们记忆中心思深沉的皇帝陛下吗？　　怕不是假的吧？！　　这种条件都敢放出来，他难道就不怕玩砸了？　　“炎文帝……是疯了？这种条件都敢放出来？”　　东虞使团的位置上，正使言锋盯着站在舞台上的炎文帝，也是满脸震惊。　　驻大炎三年了，他和炎文帝交手也有数十次了，但今日的炎文帝，怎么有点看不懂了啊！　　秦钰眉头微皱，道：“要么，他对唐逸有足够的信任，要么，有阴谋。”　　“可这场诗会需要玩什么阴谋吗？这里的人都是大炎的勋贵豪族，总不能炎文帝现在就打算对他们动手吧？”　　“没道理啊！世家豪族是大炎的毒瘤没错，但现在大炎四面楚歌，皇帝不会愚蠢到这时候动手。”　　“他，到底想干什么？”　　秦钰看不懂，一个小小的沈园诗会，为何值得皇帝下这么大的注！　　相比于秦钰的疑惑，北狄三王子宇文封的想法就简单多了，他冷冷盯着唐逸，冷笑道：“随意提任何一个条件是吧？那北境……被割让给我北狄吧！”　　他决定等下亲自下场灭掉唐逸，看炎文帝敢不敢食言。　　“唐逸，唐逸，今日，无论如何我都要将你踩在脚下……”　　舞台上，站在唐逸身后的唐画死死攥紧拳头，眼底也是炙热无比。　　只要能打败唐逸，不仅能得到皇帝亲自给他和孔诗岚赐婚，还可以和皇帝提一个条件，从此一步登天！　　“画哥哥，你的机会来了，加油……”　　看着舞台上的唐画，姜云娜也是激动无比。　　小诗仙又怎样？　　在画哥哥面前不值一提！　　“姜小姐，你刚才说什么来着？我……一个婢女？”　　这时，杜凌菲的声音传来。　　姜云娜闻言回头看去，看到杜凌菲正笑着盯着他。　　“我叫杜凌菲，江南杜家嫡女，爷爷是刚刚告老的大炎丞相杜淮忠，父亲是雍州刺史杜云锦，母亲是云阳郡主萧铃。”　　“兄长是平西大将军杜充，二兄是翰林院直学士杜允。”　　听到她的话，姜云娜只觉得腿一阵发软，导致她踉跄退了好几步，原本激动的脸瞬间苍白下来。　　江南杜家，那绝对是江南顶级豪族。　　曾经出过一位帝师，两位丞相，在大炎有着举足轻重的地位。　　而她姜云娜的爹，不过是个五品御史罢了。　　和杜家一比，什么都不是。　　刚才嘲讽杜凌菲的一群女人，这时脸色也都青红交替，就像是被人狠狠甩了两巴掌一般，脸上火辣辣的。　　刚才说人家不过是个婢女，却没想到人家的来头竟然这么大。　　没有人怀疑杜凌菲的话，冒充杜家嫡女？那是找死。　　但这怎么可能？堂堂杜家嫡女，竟然会给唐逸做婢女？！　　“呵，姜小姐，论身世，论背景，论容貌，你连我一个婢女都比不过。”　　“你，有什么值得骄傲的？”　　杜凌菲平静看了一眼姜云娜，转身跟在唐逸的身后。　　姜云娜看着足足比她高出一个头的杜凌菲，无尽的屈辱在心头蔓延，几乎瞬间将他整个人给吞噬了。　　她愤怒得攥紧拳头，指甲都镶嵌进掌心之中，却没有感觉到半点疼痛。　　该死的，你猖狂什么？你是杜家大小姐又如何？等下画哥哥将唐逸踩在脚下，看你还能不能猖狂起来。　　此时，颜霜玉也是脸色铁青，难以保持之前的从容和淡定了。　　因为之前看着她羡慕嫉妒的一群女人，此时看着她的目光都充满鄙夷，这让她愤怒到发狂，看向唐逸的双眼几乎都要溢毒了！　　小诗仙又如何？小畜生，今日有画儿在，你休想嬴！　　炎文帝看着气氛搞起来了，看向身侧的唐逸，低声道：“看到了吗？大家都这么热情，好歹你也给个回应吗？”　　“对他们，你有什么说的？霸气一点。”　　霸气一点？　　唐逸睨了一眼炎文帝，这可是你说的。　　他向前两步，目光睥睨全场，沉声开口道：“都别废话了，陛下有话说。”　　炎文帝心头一跳，当即有了不好的预感，下意识地想要拉住唐逸。　　只是唐逸的声音已经传开！　　“陛下让我告诉你们，陛下不是针对谁，除了我们兄妹和杜姑娘外，在场的所有人，都是垃圾！”　　“不服，来战！”　　全场瞬间一片死寂。　　炎文帝瞪着双眼盯着唐逸嘴角都在抽搐，朕没说，这是你说的！　　你还把你妹妹和杜凌菲除开了，你没除开朕。　　朕砍你脑袋你信不？！　　而全场盯着唐逸，也都怒火中烧，你狂妄过头了。　　就算是皇帝说的又如何？我们不敢对皇帝怎么样？还不敢对你怎么样吗？　　弄死你啊！
content_en: Tang Yi looked at the high-spirited Emperor Yanwen beside him and felt that this emperor was really crazy.If you defeat him, you can make a condition with him, Emperor Yanwen, and there is no limit... Your sister!Will you give it to someone who wants the throne from you?Will you give them the land of Dayan if they want it?If someone wants to cede land and make a king, will you give it to them?It’s crazy!Even though he was a man of two generations, Tang Yi felt a little frightened at this time. Emperor Yanwen was playing too much.Sure enough, after listening to Emperor Yanwen's words, the eyes of all the talented students participating in the competition were frighteningly bright. As long as they knocked Tang Yi down, they could ask for an official position from the emperor and soar into the sky."Tang Yi, please teach me!" "Tang Yi, use whatever skills you have, can you? I will defeat you today." "What about the little poetry fairy? I will fight with you today!" "..." In an instant, Luming Lake exploded.All the talented students participating in the competition rolled up their sleeves and stared at Tang Yi, ready to fight if they disagreed.Tang Yi was stunned when he saw this scene. He almost couldn't help but slap Emperor Yan Wen on the back of his head.Brother, are we really in the same group?Why do you feel like you are a spy sent by the enemy?These few words of yours have not only improved my morale, they have raised the enemy's morale to its peak.There is a saying that I don’t know whether to say or not: I’ll fuck you!"Your Majesty, you trust him so much?!" On the civil servant's side, Liu Wen looked extremely ugly when he saw this scene. He did not expect that Emperor Yan Wen's trust in Tang Yi would reach this level.Tang Jing, Zhao Ke and others also had pale faces and couldn't believe it.It is said that emperors are paranoid, and emperors are suspicious, but now Emperor Yanwen...why does he feel that his IQ is almost at a loss in front of Tang Yi?Is this still the thoughtful Emperor in their memories?I'm afraid it's not fake, right?!If he dares to let it go under such conditions, isn't he afraid of screwing up?"Emperor Yanwen...is he crazy? Do you dare to let him go with such conditions?" From the position of the Dongyu delegation, Yan Feng was staring at Emperor Yanwen standing on the stage, with a face full of shock.He has been stationed in Dayan for three years, and he has fought against Emperor Yanwen dozens of times, but why is Emperor Yanwen so confused today?Qin Yu frowned slightly and said, "Either he has enough trust in Tang Yi, or there is a conspiracy." "But is there any conspiracy needed for this poetry meeting? The people here are all noble and powerful families in Dayan. Emperor Yanwen can't plan to attack them now, right?""It doesn't make sense! It's true that the aristocratic families are the cancer of Dayan, but now that Dayan is besieged on all sides, the emperor will not be stupid enough to take action now." "What on earth does he want to do?" Qin Yu couldn't understand why a small Shen Yuan Poetry Club was worth the emperor's investment!Compared with Qin Yu's doubts, the thoughts of Yu Wenfeng, the third prince of Beidi, were much simpler. He stared at Tang Yi coldly and sneered: "You can make any condition at will, right? Then the northern territory... be ceded to me, Beidi!" He decided to kill Tang Yi personally later to see if Emperor Yanwen dared to break his promise."Tang Yi, Tang Yi, today, no matter what, I will trample you under my feet..." On the stage, Tang Hua, standing behind Tang Yi, clenched his fists tightly, and his eyes were extremely hot.As long as he can defeat Tang Yi, not only will the emperor personally grant him a marriage to Kong Shilan, but he can also make a condition with the emperor and reach the sky in one step!"Brother Hua, your chance has come, come on..." Looking at Tang Hua on the stage, Jiang Yunna was also extremely excited.What about the little poetry fairy?Not worth mentioning in front of Brother Hua!"Miss Jiang, what did you just say? I... a maid?" At this time, Du Lingfei's voice came.When Jiang Yunna heard this, she looked back and saw Du Lingfei staring at him with a smile."My name is Du Lingfei, the legitimate daughter of the Du family in the south of the Yangtze River. My grandfather is Du Huaizhong, the Prime Minister of Great Yan, who has just retired. My father is Du Yunjin, the governor of Yongzhou, and my mother is Xiao Ling, the princess of Yunyang County." "My elder brother is Pingxi.General Du Chong, his second brother is Du Yun, a direct bachelor of the Hanlin Academy."After hearing her words, Jiang Yunna felt her legs weaken, causing her to stumble back several steps, and her originally excited face instantly turned pale.The Jiangnan Du family is definitely the top wealthy family in Jiangnan.There was once an imperial master and two prime ministers who held a decisive position in Dayan.And her father, Jiang Yunna, was just a fifth-grade censor.Compared with the Du family, it is nothing.The group of women who had just mocked Du Lingfei now had their faces alternately turning green and red, as if someone had slapped them twice, and their faces were burning.I just said she was just a maid, but I didn’t expect her background to be so big.No one doubts Du Lingfei's words, pretending to be the legitimate daughter of the Du family?That is courting death.​But how is this possible?The dignified daughter of the Du family would actually become Tang Yi's maid?!"Oh, Miss Jiang, in terms of life experience, background, and appearance, you can't even compare to a maid like me." "What do you have to be proud of?" Du Lingfei glanced at Jiang Yunna calmly, then turned and followed Tang Yi.Jiang Yunna looked at Du Lingfei, who was a head taller than her, and endless humiliation spread in her heart, swallowing him up almost instantly.She clenched her fists in anger, her nails digging into her palms, but she didn't feel any pain.Damn it, why are you so arrogant?So what if you are the eldest lady of the Du family?Wait until Brother Hua tramples Tang Yi under his feet and see if you can still be arrogant.At this time, Yan Shuangyu's face was also livid, and it was difficult to maintain her previous calmness and calmness.Because the group of women who looked at her with envy and jealousy before now looked at her with contempt, which made her so angry that she was so angry that her eyes almost overflowed with poison when she looked at Tang Yi!What about the little poetry fairy?Little beast, if there is a painting here today, you can’t even think about winning!Emperor Yan Wen saw that the atmosphere was getting heated. He looked at Tang Yi beside him and whispered: "Did you see it? Everyone is so enthusiastic. Can you give a response anyway?" "What do you have to say to them? Be more domineering." Be more domineering?Tang Yi glanced at Emperor Yanwen, "This is what you said."He took two steps forward, looked at the whole audience, and said in a deep voice: "Stop talking nonsense, Your Majesty has something to say." Emperor Yanwen's heart skipped a beat, and he immediately had something bad to say.
title_en: Chapter 107 If you don’t accept it, come and fight!
